scenarios.given: An unanswered lease screening question
scenarios.expected: Lease candidate remains unresolved; cannot issue a no-lease conclusion.

scenarios.given: No new leases but opening lease balances remain
scenarios.expected: Continuing lease requirements are still evaluated.

scenarios.given: Only qualifying short-term leases, with a valid election
scenarios.expected: Separate recognition relief from scope and surviving disclosures.

scenarios.given: Entity rents its headquarters and leases equipment to customers
scenarios.expected: Evaluate both roles, each for its own arrangements.

scenarios.given: One contract contains a lease and service components
scenarios.expected: Route components according to reviewed interaction rules; do not globally exclude revenue or leases.

scenarios.given: Ordinary amortized-cost customer receivables with no expected loss
scenarios.expected: Do not remove the credit-loss scope merely because an allowance may be zero.

scenarios.given: Trade receivables satisfy a specific disclosure exception
scenarios.expected: Exclude only the covered disclosure requirements, not the whole credit-loss Subtopic.

scenarios.given: Employer sponsors a retirement plan but is not preparing plan statements
scenarios.expected: Route employer obligations separately from the plan reporting entity.

scenarios.given: Group includes a management business and an investment vehicle
scenarios.expected: Assess entity-specific classifications; do not inherit investment-company status across the group.

scenarios.given: Entity is not stock-exchange listed but another PBE criterion may be met
scenarios.expected: Ask the missing criterion; do not assume private-company eligibility.

scenarios.given: An acquisition or debt modification occurred and balances were later eliminated
scenarios.expected: Evaluate current and comparative transaction/disclosure requirements.

scenarios.given: No liability recorded but an executed guarantee exists
scenarios.expected: Create a guarantee candidate despite the zero trial-balance amount.

scenarios.given: One entity operates in two specialized industries
scenarios.expected: Keep both candidate modules and general Topics; resolve actual exceptions at the relevant unit.

scenarios.given: Environmental-credit activity in a period before required adoption without early election
scenarios.expected: Use the operative accounting basis and expose the issued-but-not-adopted branch; do not apply pending content silently.

scenarios.given: Government assistance before adoption of ASU 2025-10
scenarios.expected: Do not erase existing ASC 832 requirements merely because new recognition guidance is not adopted.

scenarios.given: Annual period begins exactly on a date described as beginning after in an ASU
scenarios.expected: Use the literal inclusive/exclusive date rule; test the next day separately.

scenarios.given: A requested expedient fails its entity or item eligibility test
scenarios.expected: Retain ordinary requirements and record that election is unavailable.

scenarios.given: User says no debt but a facility agreement is uploaded
scenarios.expected: Create a conflict; do not prefer either source silently.

scenarios.given: The activity screen activates an industry with no published rules
scenarios.expected: Display a coverage gap and block comprehensive sign-off.

scenarios.given: A prior yes changes to no after related outputs have been generated
scenarios.expected: Invalidate and recompute all dependent decisions while preserving the original audit record.

scenarios.given: A term has different definitions in different Subtopics
scenarios.expected: Use the definition bound to the operative requirement, not a global synonym.

scenarios.given: Entity eligibility is specified only inside a measurement clause
scenarios.expected: Apply that restriction to the measurement clause, not the whole Topic.

scenarios.given: Reviewer regards an otherwise applicable item as immaterial
scenarios.expected: Keep applicability and separately document the materiality disposition and reviewer.

scenarios.given: Same fact snapshot, corpus, rules, engine, and approved judgments
scenarios.expected: Produce identical determinations and evidence traces.

scenarios.given: Two sources reference each other
scenarios.expected: Resolve typed dependencies to a stable state; do not loop or include all linked requirements indiscriminately.

scenarios.given: Requested statements use governmental GAAP or a tax basis
scenarios.expected: Route to the appropriate framework; do not issue a FASB completeness claim.

scenarios.given: A scope paragraph changes after an assessment was approved
scenarios.expected: Keep the old assessment reproducible and create a separately reviewed change impact.

scenarios.given: Current year has a different adopted standard from the comparative period
scenarios.expected: Resolve each period and the applicable transition method, not a single today-based rule.
